main_body: A palm tree: a curved, segmented tan trunk running from the base up to a green fan of fronds that droops on both sides
top_band: none. The central column through the trunk is tan trunk segments. The frond canopy has a light green highlight at the top, but there is no flat horizontal top surface.
evidence: This is an organic palm drawn as a side-on silhouette. The trunk is a curved, ringed column and the fronds fan outward. The 3/4 top/front-face contract does not clearly apply to a plant, and no horizontal top surface is drawn. It reads more as a side or front view of a palm than as a 3/4 volume. Under the strict rules, with no top band, no front edge line and no eave shadow, it fails.

style.evidence: The fronds use about 4 to 5 greens, with a light highlight at the crown and darker greens at the drooping tips. The trunk has about 4 tan tones with ring segments and a dark brown outline, which is a tinted material tone rather than near-black. Against the references, whose canopies are dense leaf clumps in 5 to 6 greens with root detail, this palm is smaller and simpler. It has less per-leaf texture and large smooth areas on the frond blades and the trunk. The trunk and frond surfaces lack the speckled grain of the references, so density is lower. It is competent but thinner than the Beodeul pieces.
